description: Returns AskY's published guide to one Tarot de Marseille card: keywords, what the card brings, the card reversed, the card in love and in work, a piece of advice, a question to reflect on, and a link to the card's page. Accepts the card's French, English or Spanish name (for example "Le Mat", "The Fool", "El Loco", "Ace of Cups", "Reina de Espadas") or a Major Arcana number from 0 to 21 (for example "13" or "XIII"). Covers all 78 cards. Use when someone asks what a card means. It does not interpret a spread; use get_tarot_reading for a reading.

card.description: A Tarot de Marseille card: its French, English or Spanish name (e.g. "Le Mat", "The Fool", "El Loco", "Ace of Cups", "Reina de Espadas"), or a Major Arcana number 0-21 in Arabic or Roman numerals ("13", "XIII"). Spelling and accents are forgiven.

lang.description: Language of the answer: "en" for English or "es" for Spanish. Use the language the person is writing in. Defaults to "en".

name: get_card_meaning

asky.description: Data for showing the result as cards. Left out when there are no cards (for example a message instead of a reading).

name.description: French Tarot de Marseille name, e.g. "L'Hermite".

position.description: Place in the spread (readings only), else null.

reversed.description: True if the card came up reversed.

sub.description: Name in the answer's language, e.g. "The Hermit".

line.description: One-line thought or summary; null when there is none.

url.description: Page on askyreadings.com, with utm tags.

title.description: Heading, e.g. "Today's card" / "La carta de hoy".

view.description: What kind of result this is: one card, or the cards of a reading.

text.description: The full answer in Markdown, ready to show.

title: Card meaning
